chapterInfo.content:
8
Nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nson
1 # Sak 2.13; Hab 2.20 Na ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nson no ano no, ɔsoro yɛɛ dinn bɛyɛ sɛ dɔnhwereɛ fa.
2 # Mat 24.31 Na mehunuu abɔfoɔ baason a wɔgyinagyina Nyankopɔn anim no, na wɔmemaa wɔn ntotorobɛnto nson. 3#Adi 5.8 Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ ba bɛgyinaa afɔrebukyia no ho, ɔkura sika hwam kuruwa, na wɔmaa no nnuhwam pii, sɛ ɔmfa nka ahotefoɔ nyinaa mpaebɔ ho, sika afɔrebukyia a ɛsi ahennwa no anim no so. 4#Dwom 141.2 Na nnuhwam no wisie kaa ahotefoɔ mpaebɔ ho firi ɔbɔfoɔ no nsam foro kɔɔ Nyankopɔn anim. 5#Hes 10.2 Na ɔbɔfoɔ no faa ohwam kuruwa no de afɔrebukyia no so gya bi hyɛɛ mu ma, na ɔto guu asase so. Na aprannaa, ne nne ahodoɔ ne anyinam ne asasewosoɔ bae.
Totorobɛnto nson no
6Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto nson no siesiee wɔn ho sɛ wɔrebɛhyɛne.
7 # Eks 9.23-26 Na deɛ ɔdi kan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na asukɔtweaa ne ogya a ɛne mogya adi afra bae, na wɔto guu asase so. Na asase nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako hyee, na nnua nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso hyee, na nwira mono nyinaa nso hyee.
8 # Yer 51.25; Eks 7.20-21 Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na wɔtoo adeɛ bi a ɛte sɛ bepɔ kɛseɛ a ogya rehyeɛ no twenee po mu, na ɛpo nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako danee mogya, 9na abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ nkwa wɔ po mu no mu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako wuwui, na ahyɛn nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso sɛee.
10 # Yes 14.12; Dan 8.10 Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na nsoromma kɛseɛ bi a ɛredɛre sɛ ogyatɛnee firi soro hwee fam, na ɛbɛhwee nsubɔntene nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ne nsuo aniwa so. 11Na nsoromma no din de Ɔnwono, na nsuo no nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako yɛɛ nwono, na nnipa pii wuwui, nsuo no nwono a ayɛ no nti.
12 # Adi 6.12; Eks 10.21 Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na wɔbɔɔ owia nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, ne ɔsrane nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, ne nsoromma nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, na wɔn nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako no duduruu sum, na adekyeeɛ mu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako anhyerɛn, na anadwo nso saa ara.
13 # Adi 14.6; 9.12; 11.14; 12.12 Na mehunui, na metee sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ baako a ɔtu faa soro mfimfini no de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ no nnue, wɔnnue, wɔnnue, totorobɛnto a aka a abɔfoɔ baasa no rebɛhyɛne no nne no nti!

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nson no ano no, ɔsoro yɛɛ dinn bɛyɛ sɛ dɔnhwereɛ fa.
Na mehunuu abɔfoɔ baason a wɔgyinagyina Nyankopɔn anim no, na wɔmemaa wɔn ntotorobɛnto nson. Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ ba bɛgyinaa afɔrebukyia no ho, ɔkura sika hwam kuruwa, na wɔmaa no nnuhwam pii, sɛ ɔmfa nka ahotefoɔ nyinaa mpaebɔ ho, sika afɔrebukyia a ɛsi ahennwa no anim no so. Na nnuhwam no wisie kaa ahotefoɔ mpaebɔ ho firi ɔbɔfoɔ no nsam foro kɔɔ Nyankopɔn anim. Na ɔbɔfoɔ no faa ohwam kuruwa no de afɔrebukyia no so gya bi hyɛɛ mu ma, na ɔto guu asase so. Na aprannaa, ne nne ahodoɔ ne anyinam ne asasewosoɔ bae.

Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto nson no siesiee wɔn ho sɛ wɔrebɛhyɛne.
Na deɛ ɔdi kan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na asukɔtweaa ne ogya a ɛne mogya adi afra bae, na wɔto guu asase so. Na asase nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako hyee, na nnua nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso hyee, na nwira mono nyinaa nso hyee.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na wɔtoo adeɛ bi a ɛte sɛ bepɔ kɛseɛ a ogya rehyeɛ no twenee po mu, na ɛpo nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako danee mogya, na abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ nkwa wɔ po mu no mu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako wuwui, na ahyɛn nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso sɛee.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na nsoromma kɛseɛ bi a ɛredɛre sɛ ogyatɛnee firi soro hwee fam, na ɛbɛhwee nsubɔntene nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ne nsuo aniwa so. Na nsoromma no din de Ɔnwono, na nsuo no nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako yɛɛ nwono, na nnipa pii wuwui, nsuo no nwono a ayɛ no nti.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na wɔbɔɔ owia nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, ne ɔsrane nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, ne nsoromma nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, na wɔn nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako no duduruu sum, na adekyeeɛ mu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako anhyerɛn, na anadwo nso saa ara.
Na mehunui, na metee sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ baako a ɔtu faa soro mfimfini no de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ no nnue, wɔnnue, wɔnnue, totorobɛnto a aka a abɔfoɔ baasa no rebɛhyɛne no nne no nti!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
